x.description: Input array. Must have floating or complex dtype.
constraints: must have a floating or complex dtype
jax.lax.rsqrt(x, accuracy) must return an Array

accuracy.description: Optional `lax.Tolerance` or `lax.AccuracyMode` object that selects the implementation of the op based on the requested accuracy. If the implementation cannot satisfy the requested tolerance, the compiler will return an error. If mode is specified and there are no multiple implementations available, the default implementation will be used.
constraints: must be a Tolerance or AccuracyMode object, or None
jax.lax.rsqrt(x, accuracy) must return an Array

output.description: An array of the same shape and dtype as ``x`` containing the reciporical square root.

constraints: jax.lax.rsqrt(x, accuracy) must return an Array
